name: Wild carrot (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Wild carrot (Daucus carota) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DUKE, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170393 (Carrots, raw; SR Legacy) - full macronutrient, amino-acid, vitamin, mineral and fatty-acid panel
Aprifel/CIQUAL carrot nutritional sheet https://www.aprifel.com/en/nutritional-sheet/carot/ (individual sugars sucrose 4.0 / glucose 1.10 / fructose 0.90 g/100g)
Renna et al. 2021, Sustainability 13(7):3940 doi:10.3390/su13073940 (carrot landraces: total organic acids ~333.5 mg/100g FW; malate ~79%, quinate ~17%)
Metabolomic/Transcriptomic quality-formation of carrot, Horticulturae 11(5):542 doi:10.3390/horticulturae11050542 (organic-acid profile: malic dominant, plus citric/succinic/quinic/fumaric)
FooDB FOOD00072 (wild carrot, Daucus carota) - source record
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for microbial growth on carrot root: sucrose (~4 g/100g) > glucose (~1.1) > fructose (~0.9), backed by malic acid (~0.26 g/100g, the principal organic acid) with minor quinic and citric acid; starch (1.43 g/100g) is a secondary reserve. Micronutrient/AA/vitamin panel from USDA 170393. Organic-acid absolute amounts are derived from a landrace total (333.5 mg/100g) partitioned by the metabolomic fraction (malate ~79%, quinate ~17%), so individual OA values are medium
curation_added: sucrose 4.0 g/100g (dominant sugar) with real amount
malic acid (~0.26 g/100g, DOMINANT organic acid - was absent)
full vitamin panel amounts (B1/B2/B3/B5/B6/B9, C, A/carotenes, E, K, choline)
full mineral amounts (K, Na, P, Ca, Mg, Fe, Zn, Mn, Cu, Se)
L-valine and L-phenylalanine (were missing from current list)

basis: per 100 g fresh weight (edible carrot root; wild carrot Daucus carota, composition taken from cultivated/wild carrot root, USDA + carrot food-science literature)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
